tools.description: Send an outbound email from the agent's own address. Approval-gated: the send lands in the mail review queue before delivery.

safety.reason: Explicit send action; delivery itself is gated by the mail review queue.

tools.title: Get mail status
tools.description: Read the agent email rail status (configured/reachable) and the agent's provisioned address.

tools.name: allternit_mail.list
tools.title: List inbox
tools.description: List the newest messages in the agent's own Allternit Mail inbox, with any one-time codes and sign-in links found in each.

tools.name: allternit_mail.read
tools.title: Read email
tools.description: Read one message from the agent's inbox in full (the whole body is fetched from Allternit Mail when the stored copy was cut short) and mark it read.

tools.name: allternit_mail.read_otp
tools.title: Get verification code
tools.description: Return the newest one-time code or magic link the agent received, optionally waiting up to 120 seconds for it to arrive.
